context: Two teens swap travel daydreams between classes
purpose: Teach: ヴァイオリン/ディズニー/ゲル/ネオ/瓶/杉/梅田/バンコク

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ陸、今度の連休さ、私バンコクに行きたいんだけど一緒に行かない?
lines.en: Hey Riku, for the next holiday, I want to go to Bangkok — wanna come with me?
lines.style: Excited teen pitching a travel idea casually

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: バンコクかあ、屋台とか楽しそうだよね。でも俺、本当はディズニーランドに行きたいんだよなあ。
lines.en: Bangkok, huh — the food stalls sound fun. But honestly, I really wanna go to Disneyland.
lines.style: Dreamy teen daydreaming with a small whine

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、ディズニーは去年行ったじゃん。私はもっと、ネオン街がギラギラしてる所がいい!
lines.en: What — you went to Disney last year! I want somewhere with bright glowing neon streets!
lines.style: Playfully protesting with rising teenage energy

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あ、そういえば梅田の地下街もネオンすごいよ。お土産に変なラムネの瓶買って帰ろうぜ。
lines.en: Oh, speaking of which, Umeda's underground is full of neon too. Let's grab a weird ramune bottle as a souvenir.
lines.style: Suddenly remembering with cheerful suggestion tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ラムネの瓶?渋すぎ(笑)。あ、でも梅田駅の近くにヴァイオリン教室あるの知ってる?
lines.en: A ramune bottle? Way too old-school, ha. Oh, did you know there's a violin school near Umeda Station?
lines.style: Teasing then pivoting with curious tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ヴァイオリン?桜、習ってるの?俺は花粉症だから、春は杉の木のある所には絶対行きたくない。
lines.en: Violin? Sakura, are you learning it? I have hay fever, so in spring I absolutely refuse to go near cedar trees.
lines.style: Surprised then complaining about allergies dramatically

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 杉花粉ね、わかる〜。じゃあモンゴル行こうよ!草原でゲルに泊まるの、ロマンチックじゃない?
lines.en: Cedar pollen, ugh, I get it. Then let's go to Mongolia! Staying in a ger on the steppe sounds romantic, right?
lines.style: Sympathetic then leaping to wild new plan

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ゲルかよ、急にスケール大きくない?あ、もうチャイム鳴る、次の授業ヤバい、走ろう!
lines.en: A ger? The scale just jumped huge, didn't it? Oh — the bell's ringing, next class is bad, let's run!
lines.style: Laughing in disbelief then sudden urgent panic
